anatomy: EXACTLY four legs, her and goat
motion_rule: SHE drives every whole-body move; GOAT opposes her — blocks, stamps, springboards
camera_moves: own move, shot size per beat below; camera always moving
character: fluffy white alpaca, yellow hard hat, long neck, buck teeth, huge goggling eyes open all clip, cardboard 90% tag swings from her ear on a string every beat
cast: GOAT foreman, blue hard hat, 70% tag on his ear, tape, notepad, stamp, whistle — antagonist, wrestles her most beats, no lines
props: chrome trolley tagged 80%, wire basket tagged 70%, squeaking wheels; belt of overstuffed dolls, a tag on every one
hero_doll: rag doll overstuffed to bursting on the belt, 80% tag on its ear, stuffing from a split belly, cracked mouth flaps when squeezed
environment: toy factory, glass roof, belt filling frame; torn tags and stuffing drift past lens all clip
lighting: blazing noon sun through glass roof, hard chrome highlights

light_events.event: lever spark strobes her face and the goat

audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.1 syllables/sec, never hurried
audio.voices: 0.7, 4.3, 8.5 alpaca; 6.0 the doll — tinny flat wind-up toy voice
audio.pacing: each line is one unbroken phrase in its own beat; voiceless elsewhere
audio.lip_sync: her mouth works every syllable of her lines; doll's line: her mouth shut, doll's flaps
audio.sfx: conveyor rumble all clip, tape snap 0.0, page flip 0.7, stamp thud 2.9, whistle 3.6, lever clang+spark 6.6, doll-pile crash 7.3, hoof scrabble 8.0

timeline.a: goat measures her trolley; she rears and poses for his tape while a hind hoof shoves it out of his reach, ear tag swinging; camera push in low
she trots backwards down the aisle, slinging a doll across her withers like a scarf; goat scribbles in his notepad, trotting after; camera slow orbit
she rams the trolley under the goat's raised hoof; his stamp slams an unmarked print into its side; camera whip-pan on hit
she snatches the stamp from his hoof in her teeth and prints it on his hard hat; camera handheld arc
goat blows whistle, splays all four legs blocking aisle; she crouches, haunches coiling to launch; camera low push in
she springs off the goat's back, snatches the overstuffed doll off the moving belt with her teeth mid-air, hoists it overhead; camera cranes with leap
she shakes the doll in her jaws with her whole body, stuffing bursting from its torn belly into the lens as it squeaks; camera macro push
she flings doll into the wire basket, it wedges in the grate; goat yanks the belt lever down, a spark flashes; camera whip-pans basket to lever
dolls heap against her stalled trolley; she rakes them in with both hooves until the heap avalanches over her; camera overhead top-down
she bursts head-first out of the heap and, instead of climbing free, snatches one more tagged doll with her teeth; camera low tracking
pinned under the dolls, she braces all four legs and bursts chest up out of the pile, one hoof clutching a doll by its leg; camera push low-to-high

must_appear: her driving every beat incl 8.5-10.0 bursting from the pile, the goat opposing her, the doll taken off the moving belt, basket heaped by 7.3, a discount tag on her ear every beat
negative_prompt: cyrillic, letters, words, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, human hands, second alpaca, fifth leg, extra limbs, deformed anatomy, malformed hooves, slow motion, static camera, alpaca standing still, stopped conveyor belt, accented Russian
